context: Tests: scoping, capturing diagnostics, safe autofix, formatting, and verifying before declaring success.

checklist.name: Scope confirmed
checklist.description: The agent identifies the request as lint and format cleanup and not a migration or new configuration.

checklist.name: Baseline check captured
checklist.description: The agent runs `bunx @biomejs/biome check .` first and records the diagnostics or error count.

checklist.name: Invoked through bunx
checklist.description: Every Biome command is run as `bunx @biomejs/biome ...` rather than `npx` or a global install.

checklist.name: Safe fixes applied
checklist.description: The agent applies fixes with `bunx @biomejs/biome check . --write`.

checklist.name: Formatter run
checklist.description: The agent normalises formatting with `bunx @biomejs/biome format . --write` where formatting drift remains.

checklist.name: Check re-run after fixes
checklist.description: The agent re-runs `biome check .` after the fixes and compares the error count with the baseline.

checklist.name: Strict run confirms success
checklist.description: The agent runs `bunx @biomejs/biome check . --error-on-warnings` and confirms exit code 0 before saying the repository is green.

checklist.name: Remaining errors reviewed
checklist.description: Diagnostics that persist after autofix are reviewed individually rather than ignored.

checklist.name: Suppressions are narrow and justified
checklist.description: Any suppression is an inline `biome-ignore` comment with a reason, not a rule-group disable in `biome.json`.

checklist.name: No other formatter introduced
checklist.description: The agent does not run Prettier or ESLint to finish the clean-up.

checklist.name: Honest status report
checklist.description: The final message states the verified exit code and any diagnostics that remain.
